title: Valero Energy Corporation quarterly report for the quarter ended June 30, 2026
excerpt: Q2 refining operating income was $4.470 billion, refining margin was $6.342 billion, and throughput averaged 2.950 million barrels per day.
summary: The filing supports realized regional margins, throughput and outage context, operating cash flow, working capital, sustaining and turnaround spending, share count, cash, debt and lease inputs for a normalized cyclical assessment.
